# `octet_length`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
octet_length(expr)
```

Returns the byte length of string data or number of bytes of binary data.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- octet_length, example 1
> SELECT octet_length('Spark SQL');
9
```

```sql
-- octet_length, example 2
> SELECT octet_length(x'537061726b2053514c');
9
```
